_metadata.title: Central Ground Water Board (CGWB) Dynamic Ground Water Resources Assessment of India
_metadata.portal_name: CGWB / Central Ground Water Authority (CGWA) Portal
_metadata.disclaimer: Assessment units are Block / Taluka / Tehsil level per National Compilation of Dynamic Ground Water Resources.

gautam_buddha_nagar.cgwa_noc_implication: DEAL CONSTRAINT: In Over-Exploited zones, CGWA NOC for new groundwater extraction for residential/commercial projects is NOT granted unless mandatory dual-piping, zero liquid discharge (ZLD), 100% rooftop rainwater harvesting, and municipal bulk treated water tie-up is established.

delhi_new_delhi.cgwa_noc_implication: CRITICAL: Extraction of groundwater for construction is banned by Delhi Jal Board / NGT directives. Must rely strictly on treated STP water and DJB pipeline connection.

bengaluru_urban.cgwa_noc_implication: CRITICAL: Severe sub-surface depletion. Borewell drilling strictly regulated by Karnataka Ground Water Authority. BWSSB connection or onsite STP recycling mandatory.

mumbai_suburban.cgwa_noc_implication: High water table with saline ingress risks near creeks. Dewatering required during basement excavation; CGWA notification requires intimation for deep dewatering.
mumbai_suburban.risk_level: Low Resource Risk / High Foundation Dewatering Risk

hyderabad_ranga_reddy.cgwa_noc_implication: Groundwater extraction permitted subject to artificial recharge structures and mandatory digital flow meter installation.

pune.cgwa_noc_implication: Basaltic aquifer with good seasonal replenishment. Standard rainwater harvesting mandatory under Pune Municipal Bye-laws.
